TechnologyStack.Runtime: Node >=22 for the base Reasonix runtime; optional Bun >=1.3.8 for upstream MyGRACE CLI compatibility; Rust 2021 for RTK sidecar.
TechnologyStack.Language: TypeScript 5.x primary; Rust 2021 sidecar; TSX/React for web dashboard.
TechnologyStack.Framework: Reasonix CLI/dashboard architecture with React 19, Vite dashboard, Commander CLI, MCP bridge, Ink TUI, and optional Tauri desktop.

dep.name: reasonix
dep.purpose: Base agent loop, CLI, dashboard, tools, MCP, hooks, skills, memory, telemetry

dep.name: @osovv/mygrace-cli
dep.purpose: Upstream MyGRACE CLI, skills, templates, lint, MCP reference

dep.name: rtk
dep.purpose: Token-optimized command proxy and savings telemetry

dep.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
dep.purpose: SNARC and MyGRACE MCP servers; Reasonix MCP bridge

constraint-1.reason: Reasonix declares Node >=22 and uses modern runtime APIs.

constraint-2.reason: Reasonix base uses TypeScript 5.6.x and TSX runtime tooling.

constraint-3.reason: Only required for unported upstream MyGRACE CLI execution.

constraint-4.reason: RTK sidecar builds with modern Rust 2021 ecosystem dependencies.

module-level.focus: Focused Vitest files for touched TypeScript modules.

wave-level.focus: Reasonix runtime, dashboard, MyGRACE adapters, SNARC adapters, and RTK shell policy type safety.

phase-level.focus: Build, lint, typecheck, dashboard build, and test regression.

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer in-process fakes for shell, MCP, SQLite, and hook runners; do not require live DeepSeek calls in deterministic tests.

Observability.logger: Reasonix loop events, dashboard SSE events, MyGRACE log markers, RTK gain telemetry, SNARC memory stats.
Observability.redaction: Never log API keys, secrets, full raw prompts marked private, credentials, or high-risk payloads.

DeliveryShape.shape: Node-first monorepo based on Reasonix, with optional Rust RTK sidecar and local SQLite memory store.
